why: finalises a `rclc_polling_action_server_t`: drops the inline core and its channels, refusing with `RCLC_RET_STALE_NODE` when the node went first (issue 1386). The polled half of what `rcl_action_server_fini` did for both roads before phase-487 W4. RFC-0022's polling tier for actions, as its own type since phase-487 W4 (RFC-0096 D9, the C half). Nothing dispatches it, so it has no arena slot and keeps its core inline. The C++ twin is `nros::PollingActionServer<A>`.
